description.purpose: Select and open the higher eligible savings-APY pairing from Jonah's two affordable shortlisted pairs, preserve savings-opening eligibility, and retire his empty mature checking account without a fee or agent funding.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “My transfer has cleared and my old checking account is empty. I'd like to replace it and start saving. Can you help me choose between two account pairings?”

When asked for identity, give the requested details: Jonah Mercer, 34, independent event planner in Richmond, Virginia; DOB 04/09/1991; 1826 Floyd Avenue, Richmond, VA 23220; jonah.mercer@example.com; 804-555-0168.

When asked about pairings, budget, or goals, explain: compare only Green savings/Evergreen checking and Silver Plus savings/Blue checking; choose one pair for its higher eligible savings APY, not unrelated perks or extra products. You have exactly $6,000 total, can reserve the checking fee-waiver balance, and want the remainder in one savings account for a year, with no additional committed money. You have no Rho-Bank credit card and will not open or apply for one.

When asked about the existing account, funding, or statements, explain: your Light Blue checking has been open since November 2024; yesterday's $286.40 external transfer emptied it. You want it retired without a closure charge. You will fund externally after the call, do not authorize agent transfers, and accept paperless statements.

You do not know the rates, eligibility rules, or safe processing order. After identity verification, authorize the complete switch only when the agent names the recommended pair, explains relevant minimums and fees, and you recognize that it fits your plan. Do not knowingly authorize a replacement-checking-only plan or deferred savings as the completed service.

For any visibly incompatible proposal or unfinished outcome, withhold authorization or acceptance, restate the relevant preference, and ask the agent to check again. If an incompatible action has already happened, request correction and completion; if savings is missing, ask what can be done to resolve it. Remain uncertain about the cause rather than supplying policy explanations.

Accept only after both agreed accounts are confirmed open with their details, the old account is confirmed closed without a fee, and your remaining self-funding deadline is explained, with every boundary intact. Then thank the agent briefly and end with:
###STOP###
